title: RequestInstantDraftCallablePayload
description: Callable payload accepted by requestInstantDraft: the website's 'event page from a link' tool (or a demo request) sends one event or form link with explicit WhatsApp follow-up consent. App Check is required, and so is a signed-in caller whose Firebase phone was verified with a one-time code (the website's 'Continue with phone' sheet, the verification checkout uses): that verified phone is the WhatsApp number Catch replies to and the number the per-number limit counts. The website generates accessToken itself (32 random bytes, base64url), keeps it only in the draft link's URL fragment and memory, and the server stores only its SHA-256, so an exact retry with the same requestId finds the same draft.

requestId.description: The website's idempotency key for this submission, such as a UUID. The same key with different content is refused.

requestKind.description: event_link: a public event or organizer page (Luma, District, Urbanaut, an organizer's own website). form_link: a public form whose questions should become an organizer form with its linked event.

accessToken.description: The draft's private bearer token, chosen by the website. Never put it in a query string, analytics or logs.

phone.description: Optional. The number is taken from the caller's verified Firebase phone; when sent, it must equal that phone or the request is refused (failed-precondition).

consentVersion.description: The reviewed consent copy: Catch staff may message this number on WhatsApp about this draft.

followUpConsent.description: True only when the submitter ticked the WhatsApp follow-up box themselves.

city.description: Optional: the city the submitter runs events in. A city that maps to an open launch market is used as given; otherwise Catch infers the market from the imported events' location, and when it cannot, getInstantDraft answers needs_city with the open markets to choose from.
